settings.heading: The making
settings.content: Made to order, one at a time, and numbered to the edition. Printed, bound, or poured when you claim it — packed in 3–5 business days.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content:
Packed by hand in 3–5 business days, then 2–5 business days in the post — about 5–10 business days to your door. Express arrives in 4–8. Free US shipping over $70; Standard $8, Express $15.

Gracious, calm returns within 30 days — write to the house and we'll sort it.
